description: This file defines a ResultSet class for PurchaseList in a Perl ORM schema, including methods for sorting and counting items.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::PurchaseList
classes.description: A ResultSet class for handling collections of PurchaseList records with custom sorting and item count methods.

methods.name: sorted_by_columns
methods.description: Returns the columns used for sorting PurchaseList records, specifically 'date' and 'name'.

methods.name: with_item_count
methods.description: Returns a search result with an additional column 'item_count' representing the number of items associated with each purchase list.
